# Settings

## Me in chats

Your name and colour, used for your side of a [Side by side](side-by-side.md) chat.

## Appearance

Choose **Light**, **Dark** or **System**. System matches your phone's light or dark setting.

## Show mode colours

The colours a message starts in when you [show it](show.md): black on white, white on black, or yellow on black.

## Built-in templates

**Restore built-in templates** brings back any built-in templates you've deleted. Built-in templates you still have, including ones you've edited, are left as they are.
